title: record-evidence does not flip NEXT_TASKS status — reconcile-work or task completion flow is required
summary: For direct mission work, checkpoint/record-evidence only appends to the execution ledger; NEXT_TASKS.json task status is unchanged, and the finish gate still reports pending tasks. Write the task deliverable file first, then record-evidence (auto-completes when deliverable+deps present), or use mission_controller reconcile-work for externally completed work.
reusable_steps: For direct mission work, checkpoint/record-evidence only appends to the execution ledger; NEXT_TASKS
json task status is unchanged, and the finish gate still reports pending tasks

expected_outcome: Observed on MSN-GOV-BROWSER-20261022: after verify/distill, finish failed with pending tasks even though record-evidence had been called. Fix: create each task deliverable in evidence/, then record-evidence in dependency order — tasks auto-complete. For review-kind tasks, use review-task with an independent reviewer after implementer evidence exists (independence is only evaluated once the implementer actor is recorded).
